summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in listed infrastructure companies. For purposes of the 80% policy, the managers define listed infrastructure companies as publicly traded companies engaged in the development, operation, and/or management of infrastructure assets. Infrastructure assets include but are not limited to utilities (electric, gas, water), transportation infrastructure etc.
